If your order (rental) arrived with a damaged item, here’s what to do:

Document everything: On the day it arrives, record a clear video and take time‑stamped photos of the full item and the damage.
Notify the lender immediately via the app and share the evidence.
If the item is unusable/poor condition, arrange to return it within 24 hours and submit a refund request to the lender.
Keep all conversation history and any postage proof in case of a dispute.
If you can’t resolve things with the lender within 7 days, or they don’t respond to your refund/damage messages (72 hours+), email help@byrotation.com with rental details, photos, and chat screenshots so we can review and mediate.

If you need more help, you can ask to speak to a customer representative agent.

Yes, a damaged item is handled differently from a normal return.

Normal return: You just send the item back on time, in the same condition you received it (no new damage, stains, or alterations), using tracked postage or in‑person return.
Damaged item: You must document damage (photos/video), notify the other party immediately (within the inspection/24‑hour window), try to resolve it between you, and if unresolved after the required days, you can escalate it as a formal dispute where we may arrange repair or reimbursement.

If you need more help, you can ask to speak to a customer representative agent.

Do you need photos, and where do I send them?
Yes, photos (and especially videos with timestamps) are needed as proof of condition for both lenders and renters. You should:
Lenders: Take photos/videos before sending and after return; keep them and share with the renter only if there’s an issue or dispute.
Renters: Take photos/videos on receipt and before return; keep them and share with the lender if the item’s condition is different or damage occurs.
The guidance talks about taking and keeping this evidence and using it in communication or disputes, not about sending it to a separate upload/email address beyond the normal in-app conversations and any dispute process.

Will I get a replacement or a refund?
It really depends on what’s happened with your rental:
Damage, loss or theft: We don’t send replacements; instead the renter must pay for repair, replacement or market value of the item.
Item late, poor condition, or misrepresented/doesn’t fit (depending on lender policy): You may be eligible for a refund or app credit, usually if you return the item within 24 hours and follow the refund steps in the app.
So you’ll usually get money back (refund/credit) rather than a replacement item.
